text.tspan: Dynamic provisioning: from PVC to a real disk
WaitForFirstConsumer: the disk is created only after the pod is scheduled, in the pod's AZ.
reclaimPolicy (Delete / Retain) decides what happens to the disk when the PVC is deleted.
